configurations._comment: Review a branch's UI without disturbing the operator instance on :8502. Sources .env so endpoint-gated controls (the Feedback button) actually render, and runs on 8512 so both can be up at once -- the dashboard opens DuckDB read-only, so a second reader is safe.
configurations.name: dashboard-dev
runtimeArgs: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; CHARTING_PORT=8512 exec python3 -m dashboard.charting
